u0: You are carrying the box and no fall is awaiting recovery, or you have just restored the carrying condition. Continue toward the green exit while keeping possession; if the box slips, move into the immediate fall-recovery state. Reaching the exit ends the episode.
u1: The box has just slipped from your hands and is on the floor, leaving you empty-handed. This is the immediate-recovery window: pick the box up on your next move if possible to restore carrying progress and earn the larger recovery bonus; if you do not hold the box after the next transition, you fall into the delayed-recovery state. Stepping onto the exit takes priority and ends the episode.
u2: You missed the immediate pickup opportunity and the box remains on the floor while you are empty-handed. Navigate to the box and pick it up to resume carrying and earn the smaller recovery bonus; until then, remain in this recovery state. Once carrying is restored, continue toward the exit; reaching the exit ends the episode.
u3: Terminal state: you have reached the exit and the episode is over. No further action or additional reward is available.
